cards.name: Shinken Hakkyoken
cards.effect: Choose one of the following. Then, you may switch one active <Shunsui Kyoraku> or <Nanao Ise> on your field to resting. cards.name: Bankai
cards.effect: Choose up to two of your AP cards and switch them to active.
cards.trigger: [FINAL] If you have 0 life, place the top card of your deck into your life area.
